detailed_description: The Polar Bar Chart Generator helps you turn small datasets into a radial bar chart directly in your browser. You can edit labels and values, adjust the title, color theme, legend visibility, inner radius, and other layout controls, then review the live preview before exporting the result as PNG or SVG. It works well for quick reporting, dashboard mockups, presentations, and documentation when you want a circular chart without leaving the page.
usage_steps: Load the sample dataset or start with the default rows in the editor.
Update the chart title, then add, remove, or rename data points and values.
Adjust theme, legend visibility, inner radius, and other chart controls.
Review the live preview and refine the data until the visual matches your message.
Export the finished chart as PNG or SVG for slides, docs, or sharing.
usage_examples: Compare seasonal or cyclical values in a radial layout for a presentation.
Turn a short list of category scores into a circular chart for documentation or dashboards.
Experiment with labels, ranges, and themes before exporting a chart for sharing.

faqs.question: Can I edit the data directly?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add, remove, rename, and update values in the data editor before exporting the chart.

faqs.question: Which export formats are available?
faqs.answer: The chart can be exported as PNG or SVG from the buttons above the preview.

faqs.question: Does this connect to live data sources?
faqs.answer: No. The current tool uses manual rows and sample data in the browser.
